No spring torque, closure force or friction check exists for this row. The row's mechanism notes say 'watch: unproven spring-closed cam', and there is no dynamics (R17) run. If the follower lifts on a dipped pose, K is free between the dip floor and the lobe. On those poses the J1-K-J3 sub-chain sits 0.18-0.20 deg from its fold (see T3). K is never read: the pose comes from the hub encoders only.
